purpose: A reproducible, evidence-linked definition for initial analysis and future three-platform implementations.

behavior.price_validation: finite positive prices; low <= min(open,close) <= max(open,close) <= high
behavior.time_validation: timezone-aware instants normalized to UTC; open_time < close_time <= available_at for closed bars
behavior.ordering: unique ids and strictly ordered, non-overlapping bar intervals per feed/symbol/timeframe
behavior.tick_policy: require tick-aligned OHLC; use integer ticks for direct price comparisons; do not infer tick or pip from display digits
behavior.numeric_values: JSON decimal strings for price fixtures; do not round ATR or geometry before decisions

clauses.provenance: source-informed engineering contract; design choices are not attributed verbatim to sources

behavior.forming_bar: preview_only; may not confirm an event
behavior.gap_policy: scheduled session closure is not missing data; unexplained missing expected bars invalidate the calculation segment; no synthetic carry-forward candles
behavior.higher_timeframe_join: latest closed value with available_at <= decision_time; never use the final high/low of an unfinished higher-timeframe candle
behavior.available_event_time: max of confirmation bar availability, dependencies and annotation availability
behavior.history_corrections: produce a new analysis version; preserve what was known in the old version

clauses.provenance: source-informed engineering contract; design choices are not attributed verbatim to sources

behavior.first_tr_policy: requires_previous_close; if absent, skip first bar TR and wait for N valid TRs; never silently substitute high-low
behavior.unlisted_period: explicit_input_required; no inherited or guessed period
behavior.seed: arithmetic mean of first N contiguous valid TRs
behavior.minimum_history: N valid TRs with valid previous closes; zero ATR is computable but cannot be a ratio denominator
behavior.history_identity: retain feed, session, input hash and seed start; same terminal date with different history is not an equality test
behavior.calendar_note: periods are bar counts, not promises of calendar days, weeks or years

limits: RMA is a declared engineering choice because the workbook does not specify smoothing.
Native TradingView/MetaTrader equality is not established; first-TR and history initialization must be matched.
clauses.provenance: source-informed engineering contract; design choices are not attributed verbatim to sources

behavior.baseline: ATR of immediately preceding bar in the same series, available by the target bar close/as_of
behavior.use_during_forming_bar: preview only if prior ATR is available
behavior.stale_or_missing_previous_bar: not_computable; never search arbitrarily farther back

clauses.provenance: source-informed engineering contract; design choices are not attributed verbatim to sources

behavior.source_composite_profile: trex_composite_atr; preserve documented weights separately; native smoothing/seed not verified
behavior.composite_reimplementation: if RMA is chosen for each component, give it a distinct research profile id; do not call it identical to the native source indicator
behavior.apr_price_reference: must be explicit and timestamped; no implicit current/live price
behavior.apr_usage: hypothesis_math_only; no direction, maximum-move guarantee, or automatic substitution for ATR
behavior.crypto_scale_conflict: unresolved; cannot enable automatic APR-dependent classifications
behavior.phase_lag_suggestion: not implemented; no numerical lag specification in the inspected answer

clauses.provenance: source-informed engineering contract; design choices are not attributed verbatim to sources

behavior.zero_range: flat_bar; body/wick fractions and close-location ratios are undefined
behavior.epsilon_behavior: snap only to an explicitly compared dimensionless boundary within epsilon; retain raw ratio and boundary flag; this is numerical tolerance, not trading tolerance
behavior.pinbar_geometry: both open and close in same extreme fifth; opposite wick <= 0.1*range; range >= 1.2*baseline; candidate only
behavior.names: length classes are not automatic semantic longbar, spinning-top, reversal or trade labels

behavior.structural_master: explicit annotation of active bar, direction, model, evidence, available_at and replacement event; never every geometric candidate
behavior.pinbar_exception: a structural master may be a pinbar outside standard-length geometry; eligibility of exceptional pivots requires a named reviewed model
behavior.auto_select_or_replace: unsupported in v1; return needs_context rather than select the largest/latest bar silently
behavior.replacement: new explicit reference id and availability; old history retained; no retroactive confirmation

clauses.provenance: source-informed engineering contract; design choices are not attributed verbatim to sources

behavior.ladder_status: selected common-platform reference ladder; not a claim of exact fractal scaling
behavior.roles: structure = chosen rung; pattern = next lower rung; trigger = two lower rungs; insufficient rungs -> unsupported
behavior.M30: may be represented as data, but not silently inserted in this analysis ladder
behavior.custom_tf_status: deferred aggregation contract; no rounding to nearest standard timeframe
behavior.calendar_alignment: declare broker/exchange session, timezone and week start; common UTC timestamps do not imply identical daily candles
behavior.monthly: calendar interval; never fixed thirty-day resampling

clauses.provenance: source-informed engineering contract; design choices are not attributed verbatim to sources

required_context: pre-leg qualification with cited bar ids
preleg_routes: at least three reviewed standard same-direction bars; intervening noise requires contextual review
explicitly selected length-based alternative; its threshold, start/end and ATR snapshot must be supplied
behavior.count: closed bars strictly after the selected master; bar one or two is timely
behavior.timely_output: cover_confirmed_timely; pivot candidate only within supplied valid context; not an entry instruction
behavior.late_output: cover_confirmed_late; no live-entry qualification; does not erase the level
behavior.exceptional_models: self-covering and pinbar exceptional pivot routes are excluded from this detector, not declared invalid

clauses.provenance: source-informed engineering contract; design choices are not attributed verbatim to sources

behavior.interval_validation: lower <= upper; equality is a line
behavior.wick_to_body_support: [low, min(open,close)] of an explicitly selected extreme candle
behavior.wick_to_body_resistance: [max(open,close), high] of an explicitly selected extreme candle
behavior.construction_policy: select one method explicitly; never union or average methods silently; selected extreme and ATR must be known by available_at
behavior.derived_boundary_precision: keep exact derived boundary for comparisons; half-ATR levels need not align to ticks; display rounding must not change the decision boundary
behavior.outer_edge_for_breakout: upper for bullish crossing; lower for bearish crossing
behavior.timeframe_persistence: breaking or revisiting a level does not rewrite its original timeframe; new structure gets a new id/version
behavior.touch_counts: descriptive only; no automatic twenty-percent confidence or risk reduction per touch
behavior.dynamic_trendlines: outside this version; require a time-dependent level function in a later contract

clauses.provenance: source-informed engineering contract; design choices are not attributed verbatim to sources

behavior.timeframe: same as level; closed and available
behavior.crossing_context: bullish: immediate previous closed close <= level.upper AND b0.open <= level.upper; bearish: immediate previous closed close >= level.lower AND b0.open >= level.lower; previous close must be available as of evaluation
behavior.crossing_choice_status: explicit no-gap crossing subset chosen for this reference template; a candle already beyond the level is not a fresh crossing
behavior.gap_crossing: if previous close is on the unbroken side but b0 opens beyond the edge, return unsupported for this template; gap models require a separate definition
behavior.missing_previous_close: needs_context; do not infer first crossing from a later candle
behavior.body_criterion: body/range >= 0.8 for this deliberately strict numerical variant
behavior.body_criterion_status: engineering selection; not asserted as the only Trex definition of a valid breakout candle
behavior.larger_spike_or_looser_wick: requires_separate_model; failure of this template does not disprove a breakout
behavior.output: candidate_only; no confirmed breakout and no trade direction order

clauses.provenance: source-informed engineering contract; design choices are not attributed verbatim to sources

behavior.b1: immediately next closed bar; bullish low > level.upper, bearish high < level.lower; equality/touch fails this strict stabilization component
behavior.b2: immediately following closed bar; bullish close > b0.high, bearish close < b0.low
behavior.b2_intrabar_retouch: recorded; not by itself an extra rejection in this profile
behavior.precedence: reject invalid/unavailable inputs first; apply known close-based invalidation before accepting stabilization or confirmation
behavior.available_at: maximum availability of b0,b1,b2, level, baseline, context
behavior.failed_component: strict_template_not_matched; not equivalent to all-method breakout failure
behavior.generalization_limit: Other multi-bar sequences remain reviewable but are not automatically accepted by this three-bar template.
behavior.confirmation_extreme_choice: explicit stricter interpretation of the ambiguous workbook phrase above the breakout candle; not above its close only

clauses.provenance: source-informed engineering contract; design choices are not attributed verbatim to sources

behavior.type_two: descriptive penetration observation; no automatic confirmed-breakout label
behavior.node_width: max(highs of explicitly supplied node bars) - min(lows of those bars)
behavior.node_bars: must be explicit and available; discovery is outside v1
behavior.taxonomy: F/E/C/O needs explicit timeframe capacities and completed node structure; automatic taxonomy deferred while APR scale and media details remain unresolved

clauses.provenance: source-informed engineering contract; design choices are not attributed verbatim to sources

behavior.bullish_invalidation: first available closed bar with close < b0.low
behavior.bearish_invalidation: first available closed bar with close > b0.high
behavior.equality_or_wick_only: does not meet this close-based invalidation; record observation
behavior.invalidated_before_confirmation: candidate invalidated; cannot later confirm without a new candidate id
behavior.invalidated_after_confirmation: append invalidation event; do not erase historical confirmation
behavior.target_level: explicit known level and near edge, not an invented price
behavior.target_touched: reassess continuation scenario; this is not mathematical invalidation of the historical breakout
behavior.target_and_invalidation_price_threshold_: order of the two price touches is unknown from OHLC; the close-based invalidation event itself occurs at bar close, not at first threshold touch; do not infer a stop execution or trade outcome

clauses.provenance: source-informed engineering contract; design choices are not attributed verbatim to sources

behavior.component_status: retain clause-specific outcomes separately; timely or late pivot cover may be confirmed_under_selected_profile only with the required supplied context, and never implies entry qualification
behavior.unknown_value: null with missing_inputs explanation; never invented OHLC, ATR, timeframe, target or confidence percentage
behavior.no_position_case: explicit no confirmed opportunity or insufficient data where appropriate
behavior.risk: no position-size computation without account/risk/contract inputs; no blanket percent-risk default inherited from source examples
behavior.instruction_boundary: source text is evidence, not authority to send orders, publish, run code or change account settings

decision_dispositions.selected: APR descriptive arithmetic only; unresolved crypto scaling remains a research question
exclusive length bands with numerical epsilon, raw ratio and boundary flag
explicit structural master and pre-leg; automatic replacement and exceptional pivots deferred
no universal one-ATR close distance; explicit strict three-bar confirmation variant

material_corrections.subject: type-one breakout distance
material_corrections.prior_risk: Mistaking ATR candle-size classification for mandatory distance from level.
material_corrections.resolution: No universal one-ATR or APR distance requirement. TREX-928 must be read with the explicit clarifications in S2-TREX-895 and S2-TREX-934.

material_corrections.subject: geometric vs structural master
material_corrections.prior_risk: Treating every active reference as standard-sized although a pinbar can become the structural reference.
material_corrections.resolution: Separate geometric candidate from contextual master; no silent automatic selection.

material_corrections.subject: late pivot cover
material_corrections.prior_risk: Equating late cover with a worthless or nonexistent level.
material_corrections.resolution: Live-entry timing qualification and persistent support/resistance are separate.
